This position requires the ability to handle a rapidly changing workload and can prioritize accordingly. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience, learn, and develop your career within the automotive industry. jobs.title: Service Concierge, Costa Mesa
jobs.description_text: The Service Concierge position directly interfaces with service center clients as an integral part of the customer experience. This position is responsible for varied duties in the service center such as greeting clients, answering phones, directing client inquiries, and scheduling appointments. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience, learn, and develop your career within the automotive industry.
